analysis:
The only change in this PR for the batch is a documentation edit in docs/architecture/inference.md at head lines 2966-2970. It clarifies that the cluster service re-plans after a Darkbloom update only once both Macs report the same worker build (ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild), and it links to a coordinated-update section. The two supplied units are base-text excerpts (lines 3235-4002) of unchanged surrounding documentation. They cover Flint, cluster placement, link and share probes, and served-speed records. The edited hunk itself is outside those excerpts, but its patch text is complete in file_changes.

No code, key handling, attestation, authorization, cache storage, or wire-protocol behavior is changed. T-041 (prefix cache and TTFT oracle) was retrieved as context. Nothing in the supplied units touches the SSD tier, TTL, or HMAC lookup. The doc does not alter threat-model assumptions. The described behavior is an availability and ordering refinement: deferring the re-plan until both builds match avoids a failed plan and a 600 s wait. It is not a security control.

Remaining uncertainty: the claim that oneBuild is implemented in ClusterOnboardingUpdate, and the target anchor in cluster-always-on.md, are not in the supplied evidence, and I did not verify them. This is a documentation-accuracy question, not a security regression.
